verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents native Rust, TypeScript, Go and Python SDKs, an HTTP API and a Cloud MCP endpoint. Nothing shows a maintained first-class integration with LangChain, LlamaIndex or any other RAG or agent framework. SDKs and MCP are developer building blocks or separate stories. The 'for agents, RAG' marketing line is not evidence of a framework integration, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
